meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Slack.com autoplay videos; blur or hide carousel pictures; hide the logo bar, What's New cards and footer
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, slack.com home page. Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the saved rendered DOM: autoplay videos 11, carousel pictures 12, logo bar 1, What's New cards 1, footer 1. OneTrust (`#onetrust-consent-sdk`) is present on the page and is handled by the original cookie rule. Selectors are Slack's readable `c-` and `comp-` component classes, not hashed; none depend on English text.

NOT verified: the pricing, features and help pages, desktop layout, the Slack web client (login required), the original ad and app-banner rules.
